# TS9060

> **Reserved: not currently emitted by the compiler.** This code is catalogued, but no
> typesugar check reports it yet. If your build fails, look up the code it actually prints.

**Category:** Typeclass Resolution · **Severity:** Error

## Message

```
Typeclass `{name}` is not in scope
```

## Explanation

The typeclass `{name}` is used but not imported.

typesugar typeclasses must be imported to be used:

  import { {name} } from "@typesugar/std";
  // or
  import { {name} } from "typesugar";

Common typeclasses:
- Eq, Ord, Show, Clone, Debug, Hash, Default — from @typesugar/std
- Functor, Monad, Applicative — from @typesugar/fp
